body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the target may ignore one ordinary penalty to a Success Die when it next uses a Combat Card. This grants no Action or extra die.

surges.html: The target also ignores difficult terrain during its next 1 unit of movement until the start of your next turn.
The target gains +1 Composure until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Time Thread
rider.html: Gain a Time Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one non-damaging benefit of that card ending at the start of your next turn instead ends at the end of that turn.
